summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly residential construction press release announcing statistics for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: Table 1b lists the not seasonally adjusted total privately-owned housing units authorized (building permits) for the United States at 136.4 thousand units for August 2022. Table 5b lists the not seasonally adjusted total privately-owned housing units completed for the United States at 120.8 thousand units for August 2022. This document provides the specific numerator and denominator components for the permit-to-completion ratio for August 2022, contributing one monthly data point at the start of the required 2022/08 to 2025/05 period. Preliminary values (p) are indicated for this month, meaning they may be superseded by more recent revisions in the collection.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for September 2022, released October 19, 2022. Relevant to the task: Contains Table 1b and Table 5b with Not Seasonally Adjusted (NSA) totals for total building permits and total housing completions for August and September 2022. Lists August 2022 permits at 139.0 thousand and completions at 121.1 thousand (both marked revised); September 2022 permits at 129.6 thousand and completions at 119.7 thousand (both marked preliminary). These figures provide the numerator and denominator for the 'permit-to-completion' ratio for the earliest months of the target period (2022/08–2025/05). As the data is labeled 'revised' and 'preliminary', these values are current for this release date but may be superseded by later reports in the collection according to the task's instruction that the most recent report shall prevail.
